packageRules.description: Dependabot's nuget group: one pull request for the minor and patch updates of Directory.Packages.props and the local tools in .config/dotnet-tools.json.
Dependabot's cargo group, for the native core (native/fortuna-core). The shared preset does not enable cargo, so it is enabled above; weekly, like nuget.
Dependabot proposed workflow action updates weekly, all in one pull request, with the ci prefix.
Dependabot checked the Dockerfile's base images (pinned by digest) weekly.

native-msrv's image is pinned to Cargo.toml's rust-version (native/fortuna-core): never move its Rust version on its own. Digest updates still come through. Raising rust-version means editing the image in yggdrasil.yml and this rule together.
